title: coax builds against the next cmr release from crates.io
body:
coax takes `cmr` through a path dependency in `Cargo.toml`, `cmr = { version = "0.2.0", path = "../cmr" }`. A clone without a `cmr` checkout beside it does not build. Dropping the `path` today would not help either, because coax uses cmr changes that the 0.2.0 on crates.io lacks, such as `Style::source`.

The next cmr release adds italics. cmr parses text between single `*` or `_` markers as `Inline::Italic` and marks its pieces with a new `Style::italic` field. coax turns cmr's styles into ratatui styles in `screen_style` in `src/ui.rs`, which reads `fg`, `bold`, `dim` and `underline` and nothing else, so coax would draw italic text upright.

## Proposal

- Once that release is on crates.io, drop `path` from the `cmr` entry and require the released version.
- Add `Modifier::ITALIC` in `screen_style` when `style.italic` is set.

## Open

- The cmr API is being reworked before that release. `src/ui.rs` calls `cmr::parse`, `cmr::links`, `cmr::layout` and `cmr::layout_marked`, and any of them may change. The release's changelog will list what moved.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/c836bb27
notes.text: coax builds against cmr's Document, Format and Page API and draws italics, in bbf0880. The path dependency on ../cmr stays until cmr 0.3.0 is on crates.io, which is what is left of this issue.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/df584c97
notes.text: `Cargo.toml` takes `cmr = "0.3.0"` from crates.io, with no `path`, and `Cargo.lock` resolves it from the registry. `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features` and `cargo test --all-features` pass against it. The change is uncommitted on `dev` and goes in with the 0.2.1 release batch. Close this issue with that commit's hash.
